svg.title: Effect of class priors on Gaussian Naive Bayes predictions
svg.desc: A generated three-panel chart. The first panel shows that replacing a balanced training prior with a five percent deployment prior lowers review probabilities. Two confusion matrices show false review flags falling from 159 to 13 while missed review cases increase from 10 to 32.
